WITH facet_values AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT r.class_name AS value FROM scholarship_snapshot_rows r JOIN scholarship_campaigns c ON c.slug=? WHERE r.batch_id=? AND c.status='published' AND c.public_data_approved=1 AND c.active_batch_id=r.batch_id AND c.revision=? AND r.class_name IS NOT NULL AND r.class_name<>'')
        SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM facet_values) AS total,
          (SELECT json_group_array(value) FROM
            (SELECT value FROM facet_values ORDER BY value COLLATE BINARY LIMIT ? OFFSET ?)) AS optionsJson
